defects: Nonneg hypothesis is stated on Ici (N:ℝ) instead of gold's Ioi (N:ℝ); this is only equivalent to gold's hypothesis because AntitoneOn f (Ici N) combined with nonneg on Ioi N forces f(N) ≥ f(N+1) ≥ 0 — it is not a literal restatement of the same hypothesis

Integrable hypothesis is written as Integrable f (volume.restrict (Ici (N:ℝ))) (i.e. IntegrableOn f (Ici N)) instead of gold's IntegrableOn f (Ioi (N:ℝ)); equivalent only via the fact that the singleton {N} is a null set, not a literal restatement

Conclusion is Summable (fun n => f (n + N)) (tail sequence starting at N) rather than gold's Summable (fun n => f n) (full sequence from 0); equivalent only via the standard shift-invariance of summability (summable_nat_add_iff), not the same proposition syntactically
